label: L-10
title: CurveAMMAdapter.setRoute does not validate lastToken — uninitialized local variable accepted as route terminal token
description: The local variable `lastToken` in setRoute is declared but its initialization is conditional on the loop body executing on a non-zero path entry. An all-zero path would leave lastToken as address(0). The primary claim that lastToken is always uninitialized is factually incorrect — it is set inside the loop — but there is a residual weak-input-validation concern for degenerate all-zero path arrays.
impact: No practical impact: an all-zero path causes require(lastToken == tokenOut) to revert since tokenOut != address(0). Validation is effective. Residual concern is defense-in-depth weak-input-validation.
attackPath: Only theoretical path: caller supplies path where all 11 slots are address(0)
lastToken stays address(0); require(lastToken == tokenOut) reverts since tokenOut != address(0)
No route is registered; no swap can occur with a misconfigured route — validation is effective
note: DEDUP-009 is a distinct sub-issue from ledger L-07 (setRoute accepts tokenIn==tokenOut). L-07 covers missing equality check and zero-gap segments; DEDUP-009 covers the uninitialized lastToken local variable. Both are in setRoute but have different root causes and different remediations.
